enacting_law: Pub. L. 93-406 (Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974)
legislative_history: Senate Report 93-127 (Labor and Public Welfare Committee); House Report 93-533 (Education and Labor Committee); Conference Report 93-1280
presidential_signature: President Ford signed on Labor Day, September 2, 1974
notes: ERISA was enacted on Labor Day deliberately — symbolic alignment with the labor movement's support for the legislation.
